pattern.short_summary: At a single decision point the system emits more than one alternative for the same request and presents them together as a set.
pattern.definition: At a single decision point the system emits more than one alternative for the same request and presents them together as a set. The user's control is exercised by choosing one member of the set rather than by editing or re-specifying. The chosen item is committed downstream and the unchosen ones are discarded or backgrounded.
pattern.structural_signature: Control flow forks at one point into N ≥ 2 outputs of the same type, all rendered simultaneously in a bounded display region (a row, a side-by-side triple, a separate list beside the working surface). A selection event on one member is the commit action: it writes that member into the downstream state and terminates the other branches. The multiplicity is in the outputs, not in the operations offered over one output, and the set is resolved in a single act.

dimension.category_description: How multiple possibilities are presented, previewed, maintained, blended, or compared before commitment.
dimension.classification_boundary: Requires a visible choice or comparison mechanism, not backend candidate-set processing alone.
